settings.title: Built for Performers.
settings.body:
ElectroChew was born from a simple frustration — why do electrolytes have to come in a bottle, a packet, or a pill?

We worked with chemists at our university to formulate a better solution. By delivering electrolytes directly through the oral mucosa, we created something that works faster than any drink on the market.

We're two founders from Charleston, SC who quit our jobs and bet everything on chewing gum. We believe in what we built because we use it every single day.
